text: {"patches":[{"id":"s1","action":"hedge","claim_type":null,"text":"The fluorescence preselection remains unverified because fluorimetry requires an identified fluorescent species or a justified indicator."},{"id":"s2","action":"hedge","claim_type":null,"text":"The supplied laboratory and in-vitro proof-of-concept evidence does not fully justify treating sensitivity as proof of readiness for a different application."},{"id":"s3","action":"rewrite","claim_type":null,"text":"Because broad absorption bands overlap, quantitative NIR analysis suggests the use of chemometrics for quantitative and qualitative analysis of spectral data."},{"id":"s4","action":"hedge","claim_type":null,"text":"Fluorimetry may require a defined fluorescent species or a justified fluorescent indicator."},{"id":"s5","action":"delete","claim_type":null,"text":null},{"id":"s6","action":"rewrite","claim_type":null,"text":"Overlapping NIR absorption bands suggest the use of chemometrics for quantitative and qualitative analysis of spectral data."},{"id":"s7","action":"hedge","claim_type":null,"text":"UV-Vis turbidity tracks cell density rather than cell viability, based on the correlation with turbidity."}]}
